### Pre-deployment Checklist

- [ ] Run `npm run format-blade` without error.
- [ ] Run `php artisan cache:clear` after deployment if domain's config change.
- [ ] Self-review completed.
- [ ] Database migrations reviewed (if had).
- [ ] Check if it affects other websites.
- [ ] Check if the cache (CF/php cache) needs to be cleared after deployment.
